title: knema stellata subsp. cryptocaryoides
intro: Knema stellata subsp. cryptocaryoides, commonly known as the 'Star Birch Tree' or 'Borneo Birch', is a plant species in the family Myristicaceae. It has been traditionally used in Southeast Asian cultures for its medicinal properties, offering various health benefits such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects. The therapeutic actions of Knema stellata subsp. cryptocaryoides include its ability to treat fever, cough, and respiratory issues, as well as providing relief from pain and inflammation. The bioactive constituents of this plant include triterpenoids, phenolic acids, and other compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
